title: “Ignorance is not Bliss”: Designing Personalized Moderation to Address Ableist Hate on Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through interviews and focus groups with disabled social media users using design probes. The study assesses users' perceptions of AI-based personalized moderation tools, specifically evaluating the tools' ability to accurately identify ableist hate, handle reclaimed disability-related words without false positives, and account for contextual nuances of disability identity.
